title: New ITOR Publication on Parallel Machine Scheduling with Conflicting Jobs
abstract: Research focuses on scheduling conflicting jobs on identical parallel machines with makespan minimization. Proposes a novel constraint programming (CP) model and two metaheuristics (multineighborhood simulated annealing and CP-based LNS).
